caption:
India have played one Test at Hagley Oval. It was over inside three days.

The Wellington Test was drawn, so the two-Test series against New Zealand is level. The decider starts in Christchurch on Friday at 3:30 am IST.

The last time India played there, in 2020, they led by seven runs on first innings (242 to 235). Then they were bowled out for 124 in 46 overs. Trent Boult took 4/28 and Tim Southee 3/36. New Zealand chased it down for the loss of three wickets and won the series 2-0.

This time a win takes the series for India. A loss hands it to New Zealand. A draw leaves it level.

Can India win at Hagley this time? Tell us below.
